sentences.en: Where shall we go now? To the theatre or cinema?
sentences.zh: 我们现在去哪儿？剧场还是电影院？

sentences.en: The unwaged often receive a discount at theatres and museums.
sentences.zh: 失业人员在剧场和博物馆可以享受折扣。

sentences.en: Why don't you telephone the theatre and enquire about tickets?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不给剧场打电话询问一下票的情况呢？

senses.zh: 戏院；剧场；露天剧场 (AmE theater)
